integrity: Proof and exact finite rational witness program supplied. Finite tests do not establish universal claims. Mathematical verification beyond the present review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite balanced multipartite two-distance metrics only; no result for arbitrary weights or class sizes. Minimum dimension on the plateau is determined at the metric endpoint but not for every intermediate parameter. Related results may exist in unindexed Euclidean distance geometry literature.
title: A sharp Hilbert-valued variance transition on equal-size multipartite metrics
